# The same run's client half: every change to an entity's pos/apos trajectory
# group, printed by `--net-probe` (`ProbeWatch::check_movers`). This is what
# says retail ships a mover as a trajectory the client extrapolates rather
# than as per-frame origins: one update per segment, and nothing in between.
#
# Entity numbers come from the server half's `PROBE wire_follow`,
# `PROBE wire_gravity` and `PROBE wire_spin` lines. A number is reused after
# a throwaway entity is deleted.
